name: Dolly Khanna
bio: Chennai-based veteran investor known for spotting multi-bagger small-caps early. Portfolios often filed jointly under the Khanna family.

name: Vijay Kedia
focus: SMILE — Small in size, Medium in experience, Large in aspiration, Extra-large in market potential
bio: Self-taught investor famous for the SMILE framework and long holding periods. Adept at spotting compounding businesses early.

name: Ashish Kacholia
bio: Known as the 'Big Whale' of mid/small-caps. Co-founded Hungama Digital before turning full-time investor.

name: Radhakishan Damani
focus: Value, retail, FMCG, financials (founder of D-Mart / Avenue Supermarts)
bio: Founder of Avenue Supermarts (D-Mart). One of India's most successful value investors; holds stakes via multiple entities including Derive Trading and Bright Star Investments.

name: Mukul Agrawal
bio: Aggressive accumulator across 40+ stocks; one of the most active individual investors by breadth.

name: Akash Bhansali
bio: Veteran markets professional turned full-time investor; runs a diversified public-equity book.

name: Sunil Singhania
focus: Growth-oriented broad portfolio; runs Abakkus Asset Manager (AIF)
bio: Former head of equities at Reliance Mutual Fund. Now runs Abakkus — appears both as an individual and via the Abakkus AIF.

name: Porinju Veliyath
bio: Kochi-based value investor; runs Equity Intelligence (PMS). Known for bold contrarian calls.

name: Nemish Shah
bio: Co-founder of Enam Holdings. One of India's most respected long-term quality investors.

name: Raamdeo Agrawal
focus: Quality, financials, auto (co-founder of Motilal Oswal)
bio: Co-founder & Chairman of Motilal Oswal Financial Services. Authored 'The Art of Wealth Creation'.

name: Anil Kumar Goel
bio: Chennai-based investor specialising in obscure small-cap manufacturing names.

name: Rekha Jhunjhunwala
focus: Continuation of Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's portfolio (Titan, Star Health, etc.)
bio: Inherits and continues the public-market portfolio built with the late Rakesh Jhunjhunwala.

name: Mohnish Pabrai
focus: Cloning, deep value, concentrated bets (India-focused FII)
bio: US-based value investor of Indian origin; runs Pabrai Funds. Disciplined practitioner of 'shameless cloning'.

name: Govind Capital
focus: Systematic mid/small-cap FII — frequent SAST filer
bio: Singapore-based FII known for aggressive accumulation of Indian mid/small-caps.

name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
focus: Largest domestic institutional holder across large-caps
bio: India's largest institutional investor. A >1% stake is common across the Nifty 500.
